This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The old issues you mentioned have been closed as their problems were fixed by the recent upgrade. To check the version your instance is running, you can call the health endpoint `/api/v1/health` which returns a JSON including the `version` key with the current version string, as shown in the `src/api/health.ts` file. Your provider's version number 3.2.1 matches the version set in the code's package.json and environment.
